```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(ggthemes)
library(strainspy)
library(SummarizedExperiment)

long_meta <- read_csv("./data/bjork/mdat_longi_pibble.csv")
long_sprops <- read_csv("./data/bjork/sgbs_longi_pibble.csv", col_names = TRUE)
base_meta <- read_csv("./data/bjork/mdat_baseline_survival.csv")
base_sprops <- read_csv("./data/bjork/sgbs_baseline_survival.csv")

meta_other_1 <- read_tsv("data/bjork/filereport_read_run_PRJEB43119_tsv.txt")
meta_other_2 <- read_tsv("data/bjork/filereport_read_run_PRJEB70966_tsv.txt")
meta = rbind(meta_other_1, meta_other_2)
meta$sample_title = gsub(" wgs", "", meta$sample_title)
meta$sample_title = gsub("-", "\\.", meta$sample_title)

meta$sample_title %in% c(base_meta$sampleid, long_meta$sampleid)

out_df = data.frame()

which(meta$sample_title[1] == base_meta$sampleid)
which(meta$sample_title[1] == base_meta$sampleid)

se <- read_sylph("./data/bjork/bjork_2024_profile_gtdb_220_id95.tsv.gz")
``` 
